name: The Wizard’s Secret Garden
source:
"Between happiness and the ugly truth, which one is your choice?"

The Wizard’s Secret Garden -  Once upon a time in a wizard’s secret garden In a secret garden where people rarely come by.

The green wizard drowning in blue. Wondering who will be the one who fills full his heart?  " Please...., someone help me…."

[From [url=https://note-f.itch.io/twsg]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“在幸福和丑陋的现实之间，你选择哪一个？”

巫师的秘密花园 - 很久很久以前，在一个巫师的秘密花园里，在一个很少有人经过的秘密花园里。

淹没在蓝色之中的绿色巫师。不知道谁会是那个让他心满意足的人呢？“求求你了……谁能帮帮我……”

[来自[url=https://note-f.itch.io/twsg]Itch.io[/url]]
